name: Mi 11 Ultra

images.credit: 人工知能, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Platform.Operating system: Original: MIUI 12 based on Android 11, Current: Xiaomi HyperOS 2 based on Android 14

Display.Display: 3200×1440 3K (4.6 MP) AMOLED curved screen, 6.81 inches, HDR10+, DCI-P3, 120 Hz refresh rate

Cameras.Rear camera: Triple-Camera Setup, Primary: Samsung ISOCELL GN2; 50 MP, 24mm, 1/1.12", 1.4μm, dual pixel PDAF, OIS, Periscope Telephoto: Sony Exmor IMX586; 48 MP, 120mm, 1/2.0", 0.8μm, PDAF, OIS, 5x optical zoom, Ultrawide: Sony Exmor IMX586; 48 MP, 12mm, 128˚, 1/2.0", 0.8μm, PDAF, Features: Laser AF, color spectrum sensor, Dual-LED flash, HDR, panorama, 1.1" AMOLED selfie display, Video: 8K@24fps, 4K@30/60fps, 1080p@30/60/120/240/960/1920fps, gyro-EIS, HDR10+ rec.
Cameras.Front camera: Samsung ISOCELL Slim S5K3T2; 20 MP, 27mm (wide), 1/3.4", 0.8μm, Features: HDR, panorama, Video: 1080p@30/60fps, 720p@120fps, gyro-EIS

Sound.Sound: Stereo speakers tuned by Harman Kardon, lower main microphone, upper noise reduction microphone, back noise reduction microphone

Battery.Charging: QC 4+/QC3+/PD3.0 67 W wired fast charging, 67 W wireless fast charging, 10 W wireless reverse charging

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/6e (2.4 & 5GHz), dual-band, WiFi Direct, hotspot Bluetooth V5.2, A2DP, Low-energy, aptX HD, aptX Adaptive
